notices.title: City Council Public Hearing - Notice of Intent to Annex Andover Property
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING FOR PROPOSED ANNEXATION

Notice is hereby given that the City Council of the City of Saratoga Springs, Utah, at their meeting of October 6,  has approved Resolution R26-50 (10-06-26), pursuant to Utah Code § 10-2-812, indicating its intent on annexing property owned by the City of Saratoga Springs which constitutes all or part of an unincorporated island or peninsula of Utah County, a county of the second class, contiguous to and/or surrounded by land of the City of Saratoga Springs, Utah, which property is more specifically described as follows:

PROPERTY DESCRIPTION
A PARCEL OF LAND LYING AND SITUATE IN THE SOUTHWEST QUARTER OF SECTION 19, TOWNSHIP 5 SOUTH, RANGE 1 EAST, SALT LAKE BASE AND MERIDIAN. BASIS OF BEARING FOR SUBJECT PARCEL BEING NORTH 00°10'25' WEST 2651.16 FEET (MEASURED) (COINCIDENT WITH THE WEST LINE OF SAID SOUTHWEST QUARTER OF SECTION 19. SUBJECT PARCEL BEING MORE PARTICULARLY DESCRIBED AS FOLLOWS: COMMENCING AT THE SOUTHWEST CORNER OF SECTION 19, TOWNSHIP 5 SOUTH, RANGE 1 EAST, SALT LAKE BASE AND MERIDIAN, THENCE NORTH 00°10'25' WEST 1022.61 FEET COINCIDENT WITH THE WEST LINE OF THE SOUTHWEST QUARTER OF SAID SECTION 19; THENCE NORTH 89°49'34' EAST 1658.79 FEET; THENCE THE FOLLOWING FIVE (5) COURSES COINCIDENT WITH THE EAST BOUNDARIES OF THE SARATOGA ROAD AND 145 NORTH STREETS DEDICATION PLAT (ENTRY 1919:2020) AND THE PERELLE MEADOWS PHASE 3 SUBDIVISION PLAT (ENTRY 1918:2020): 1) NORTHERLY 28.83 FEET ALONG THE ARC OF A 25.00 FOOT RADIUS CURVE TO THE RIGHT (CENTER BEARS NORTH 23°08'13' EAST) THROUGH A CENTRAL ANGLE OF 66°04'35' TO A POINT OF TANGENCY; 2) NORTH 00°47'12' WEST 200.07 FEET; 3) NORTH 89°46'07' WEST 24.86 FEET; 4) NORTH 00°04'29' WEST 389.35 FEET; AND 5) SOUTH 89°53'04' EAST 3.52 FEET TO A POINT ON A COMMON CORNER OF THE PERELLE MEADOWS PHASE 3 PLAT AND THE EAST LINE OF THE SAID PERELLE MEADOWS ANNEXATION (RECORDED AS ENTRY 11291:2017 MAP # 15767) AND THE TOWN OF SARATOGA SPRINGS INCORPORATION PLAT BOUNDARY (RECORDED AS ENTRY 103823:1997 MAP # 7374) AND THE TRUE POINT OF BEGINNING: THENCE CONTINUING COINCIDENT WITH THE EAST LINE OF SAID PERELLE MEADOWS PHASE 3 PLAT AND THE EAST LINE OF THE SAID PERELLE MEADOWS ANNEXATION NORTH 01°03'23' WEST 24.91 FEET; THENCE SOUTH 89°53'02' EAST 357.75 FEET; THENCE SOUTH 01°07'47' EAST 9.61 FEET; THENCE NORTH 89°14'11' EAST 15.30 FEET; THENCE SOUTH 00°07'14' EAST 15.30 FEET TO A POINT ON THE SAID TOWN OF SARATOGA SPRINGS INCORPORATION BOUNDARY; THENCE SOUTH 89°41'14' WEST 15.30 FEET COINCIDENT WITH SAID TOWN INCORPORATION BOUNDARY; AND CONTINUING COINCIDENT WITH SAID TOWN BOUNDARY NORTH 89°53'04' WEST 358.00 FT MORE OR LESS FEET TO THE POINT OF BEGINNING.

The City of Saratoga Springs City Council will hold a public hearing on the proposed annexation on
November 10, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. at City Council Chambers, 319 S. Saratoga Road, Saratoga Springs, Utah 84045. 

The City Council will annex the area unless, at or before the public hearing, written protests to the annexation are filed by the owners of private real property that: (a) is located within the area proposed for annexation; (b) covers a majority of the total private land area within the entire area proposed for annexation; and (c) is equal in value to at least 1/2 the value of all private real property within the entire area proposed for annexation. 

The annexation petition and plat map are available for inspection and copying at the office of the City Recorder. 

Posted: October 9, 2026.
Publication Method: Class B - UPNW, City Notice Website, Owners, Affected Entity Mailer, Physical Location.

/s/ Nicolette Fike, City Recorder

NOTICE OF ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE

Notice is hereby given that the City Council of the City of Saratoga Springs, Utah, at their meeting of October 6, 2026, passed and adopted the following Ordinances:

26-43 (10-06-26) Repealing the previous Annexation Policy Plan and Map, Adopting a Revised Annexation Policy Plan and Map, and Establishing an Effective Date.
26-44 (10-06-26) Adopting an Amended Storm Drainage Impact Fee Facilities Plan, Amended Storm Drainage Impact Fee Analysis, and Amended Storm Drainage Facilities Impact Fee.
26-45 (10-06-26) Adopting an Amendment to the Land Use Map of the General Plan, and Adopting an Amendment to the Official Zoning Map of certain real property in the City.
26-46 (10-06-26) Adopting an Amendment to the Land Use Map of the General Plan, Adopting an Amendment to the Official Zoning Map, and Approving a Development Agreement specifying the terms of the development of certain real property in the City.
26-47 (10-06-26) Adopting an Amendment to title 19 of the Saratoga Springs City Code, and Establishing an effective date.
26-49 (10-06-26) Vacating a Sewer Easement, a portion of Public Road, Storm Drain Easements, and a Modification to the Alignment of a Public Utility Easement.

Copies of these Ordinances are on file in the office of the City of Saratoga Springs City Recorder and are available for review during business hours.



This notice has been posted on:
The Utah Public Notice Website,
The City of Saratoga Springs Website, and
The City of Saratoga Springs administration building notice board.


Dated: October 7, 2026
/s/ Nicolette Fike, City Recorder

notices.title: City Council Public Hearing - Notice of Vacating Easements
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING

The City of Saratoga Springs, Utah proposes to vacate easements and rights-of-way. The City Council will hold a public hearing on October 6th, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. at 319 S. Saratoga Rd., Saratoga Springs UT, to discuss the proposed the right-of-way, and easement vacations.

1.	Vacation of Sewer Easement S-1, Ut. County Document Recording Entry No. 2013-59717, The easement is no longer needed for sewer infrastructure.

2.	Vacation of Storm Drain Easement SD-11, Ut. County Document Recording Entry No.2013-59717, To remove the City as grantee and grant a new easement to the HOA for ongoing access and maintenance of the SD-11 storm drain pond.

3.	Vacation of 2013 SD-9 Storm Drain Easement, Ut. County Document Recording Entry No. 2013-59717, The easement is no longer needed.

4.	Vacation of 2014 SD-9 Storm Drain Easement, Ut. County Document Recording Entry No. 46496:2014, To remove the City as grantee and grant a new easement to the HOA for legal access and long-term maintenance of the SD-9 storm drain pond.

5.	Vacation of Stub Road Right-of-Way on Swainson Avenue, The stub road is no longer needed for access. 
6.	Modification of Public Utility Easement (PUE) - Swainson Avenue, Ut. County Document Recording Entry No. 46495:2014, With the vacation of the stub road ROW, this jog is no longer necessary.
Public Hearing Comments may be submitted to comments@saratogaspringscity.com.  
Comments & Questions may be directed to the Planning dept. 801-766-9793 x155.

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING

Notice is hereby given that the City of Saratoga Springs City Council will conduct a public hearing to consider public input regarding the adoption of an amended Impact Fee Facilities Plans Impact Fee Analyses, and Amended Impact Fees for Storm Drainage.

The hearing will be conducted during the regular City Council meeting beginning at 6:00 p.m. on Tuesday, October 6, 2025, at the City Offices located at 319 S. Saratoga Road, Saratoga Springs, Utah 84045. Following the public hearing, the City Council will vote on whether to approve the items. 

The Impact Fees Facilities Plan, executive summary of the Impact Facilities Plan and Impact Fee Analysis, executive summaries of the Impact Fee Analysis, and a draft of the proposed enactment/ordinance wherein the amended impact fees are enacted are available at the Saratoga Springs Public Library building at 1307 N Commerce Dr. Suite 100, on the City's website at www.saratogasprings-ut.gov and upon request. 

Questions may be directed to the Engineering dept. 801-766-9793.  
Public Comments may also be submitted to comments@saratogasprings-ut.gov
